label: GO step in the final ~10 trials of the episode (low model value), strongest when choosing a2
explanation: Fires almost only at GO (99.6% of mass), and only late in the episode: never before ep_trial 79, 4% rate at trials 80-89, 26% at trials 90-99. Equivalently it fires when the model value-head output is low (99% of mass at value < 5.22), since value drops as the episode end approaches. Recorded (phase==GO)&(value<5.0) (dev F1 0.85, mass recall 0.97); (phase==GO)&(ep_trial>=90) is about equal (F1 0.80, mass recall 0.95). Both use only observed or computed quantities. Magnitude is modulated by choice: the top activations are almost all a2 choices (98% of the top quartile is covered by action==2 within trials 90+), while a1 choices late in the episode give weak or no activation and account for most false positives. It does not fire at D2, and almost never at D1 (only rare penalty or fixation-error steps). It is not driven by reward, transition or stay/switch history.

issues: Claims hold on the test split. Predicate (phase==GO)&(value<5.0): P 0.836, R 0.878, F1 0.857, mass recall 0.971. phase==GO alone: recall 0.988, mass recall 0.997. D2: mass 0. D1: mass ~0.001. ep_trial<79: 0 active steps. GO at trials 80-89: precision 0.10.

Minor overstatement: 'late-episode a1 choices give weak or no activation' is too strong. (phase==GO)&(value<5)&(action==1) still has precision 0.69 (13.9k steps predicted), but those activations are weak (mass recall 0.16). It is true that a1 makes up most of the false positives (~4.3k of 5.9k).

Systematic but modest gap: the value cutoff depends on the choice. Misses are mostly a2 GO steps with value just above 5. False positives are mostly a1 GO steps. A cutoff that depends on action fixes part of this (test F1 0.902 vs 0.857). This sharpens 'strongest when choosing a2' but does not contradict the label.
Late-episode position and value are interchangeable proxies (ep_trial>=90 version is slightly worse). No future variables are used.
skeptic.revised_label: GO step when the model's value is low (final ~10 trials of the episode), with a higher value cutoff for a2 choices than for a1, so a2 choices fire earlier and more strongly
